items.mainDefect: When V2 is active, the ClientRemovedEvent listener in AdminPermissions calls ClientPermissionsV2.setPermissionsEnabled, which throws UnsupportedOperationException and can abort the client deletion.

secondary.defect: The role and group removal paths in V2 may throw the same UnsupportedOperationException from their setPermissionsEnabled calls.

items.mainDefect: In V2, ClientResource's management permissions endpoint unconditionally calls isPermissionsEnabled, setPermissionsEnabled, resource and getPermissions; these throw UnsupportedOperationException, so the request fails with HTTP 500 instead of a clean 4xx.

secondary.defect: When both V1 and V2 are enabled, the ClientRemovedEvent listener in AdminPermissions hits the same UnsupportedOperationException from setPermissionsEnabled.

items.mainDefect: In V2, isPermissionsEnabled and setPermissionsEnabled throw instead of returning safe values, so the ClientResource management endpoints fail instead of returning a proper 4xx or feature-disabled response.

secondary.defect: In V2, canExchangeTo throws instead of returning false, which breaks the token exchange callers.
